subject: Private deployment architecture deep-dive — scheduling and readiness
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment architecture deep-dive — scheduling and readiness

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to run a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive to walk through NovaHealth's private deployment requirements (VPC peering, on-prem containerization, and air-gapped provisioning). Goal: validate the network/security constraints and agree a rollout checklist so we can size Dedicated/private options and prepare a deployment runbook.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 19 May — 9:00–10:15am
- Tue 19 May — 2:00–3:15pm
- Wed 20 May — 11:00–12:15pm

Please let me know which works for you and whether any of your infra/security folks (or procurement) should be on the call. I've attached a short pre-demo questionnaire — filling that out will help us prioritize the agenda.

Attachments: [Attachment: pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

If none of the above work, happy to send a calendar poll.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Singh <raj.singh@novahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment architecture deep-dive — scheduling and readiness

Hi Aditya —

Thanks — all three slots look reasonable. Raj (our Head of Cloud Operations) is looped in — he's the primary technical owner for VPC and air-gapped installs. Quick notes from our side:
- We prefer Wed 20 May 11:00–12:15 (PDT).
- We'll need the RD to confirm whether Redwood can provide an offline installer and an HSM/KMS integration plan in advance.
- I'll try to fill out the pre-demo questionnaire today; Raj will join the call with our network diagram.

Can you include any pre-read or network connectivity checklist we should review?

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, IT Operations
NovaHealth

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novahealth.com>, Raj Singh <raj.singh@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment architecture deep-dive — scheduling and readiness

Perfect — Wed 20 May 11:00–12:15 (PDT) locked in pending calendar accept.

Olga/Vivek — can one of you take the tech lead on this call? We should cover:
- VPC peering patterns + firewall/egress rules (what endpoints we need to whitelist)
- On-prem host/VM sizing and container runtime requirements
- Air-gapped installer flow and offline dependency list (we can share a tarball + install checklist)
- KMS/HSM integration options and key rotation expectations
- Rollout plan: PoC -> pilot -> production (timelines + success criteria)

Elaine/Raj — attaching a short internal readiness checklist and a sample agenda. Raj — if you can drop a high-level network diagram before EOD Mon that would save time.

Attachments: [Attachment: internal-readiness-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)], [Attachment: deploy-architecture-agenda.pdf (pdf)]

Also linking a quick one-pager on our offline installer approach: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C

I will send the invite with Zoom and a break-out room for ops/security.

Cheers,
Aditya

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novahealth.com>, Raj Singh <raj.singh@novahealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 May 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment architecture deep-dive — scheduling and readiness

Thanks everyone — invite sent for Wed 20 May 11:00–12:15 (PDT).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/999888777
Pre-read (same folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C

Quick agenda (high level):
1) 5m — Introductions and goals
2) 20m — NovaHealth current infra and constraints (Raj)
3) 25m — Redwood deployment options + offline installer deep-dive (Olga/Vivek)
4) 15m — KMS/HSM and audit/logging expectations
5) 10m — Next steps and required artifacts for pilot

Attachments: [Attachment: network-diagram-stub.png (png)]

If Raj needs to move the slot, please let us know; otherwise we'll proceed and record the session for the stakeholders who can't make it.

—Olga
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
